Axiom: Review lifecycle owns this exact VCS surface. Resolve every placeholder to a literal argument before one command call; never use shell substitution, variables, pipes, loops, `echo`, redirection, or `--help`. A ref literal is valid only when it uses ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore, slash, or hyphen; starts with a letter or digit; is at most 128 characters; and has no empty, dot, dot-dot, terminal-dot, terminal-slash, `.lock`, or `@{` component/form. A review slug is derived from the primary spec's canonical scope segment and must match `[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*`. A PR number is a non-zero decimal integer. Read/freeze: `git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all`, `git hash-object -- `, `git diff --cached --name-only`, `git diff --exit-code -- `, `git ls-files --stage -- `, `git rev-parse HEAD`, `git branch --show-current`, `gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef --jq .defaultBranchRef.name`. Derive, validate, and freeze literal ``, ``, and `` before mutation. Immediately before both staging and commit, rerun `git branch --show-current` and require exact equality with frozen ``. Write the complete PR body only through a file-write tool to `.claude/tmp/sdd-review-.md`, freeze that literal as ``, and pass its opaque bytes only by `--body-file `. Never place any PR-body text in a shell command. Publish: `git add -- `, `git commit -m "sdd(): publish specification"`, `git push --set-upstream origin `, `gh pr list --head --base --state open --json number,url --limit 2`, `gh pr create --base --head --title "SDD : publish specification" --body-file `, or `gh pr edit --base --title "SDD : publish specification" --body-file `. After create, rerun the same head-plus-base list command; after create or reuse require exactly one row, validate and freeze its literal `` and ``, and use that number for every later PR operation. Prove publication with `gh pr view --json number,url,headRefOid,baseRefName,state --jq '{number:.number,url:.url,headRefOid:.headRefOid,baseRefName:.baseRefName,state:.state}'`. Merge/prove: `gh pr merge --merge --match-head-commit `, `gh pr view --json state,mergedAt,mergeCommit,baseRefName --jq '{state:.state,mergedAt:.mergedAt,mergeCommitOid:.mergeCommit.oid,baseRefName:.baseRefName}'`, `git fetch origin `, and `git merge-base --is-ancestor FETCH_HEAD`. Copy each command's literal output (or exact exit code for the ancestry check) into orchestration state/report; never reconstruct or capture it through shell syntax. No other mutating VCS command, squash, rebase, force-push, or implicit interactive prompt is allowed.
